crime: During midday free time, {WITCH_NAME}'s reading partner always brought two ordinary library books to the lounge. They sat on the same sofa facing the fireplace. The reading partner chose the book and the order of its sections, then listened while {WITCH_NAME} read aloud.

On the day of the murder, the reading partner set both books before {WITCH_NAME} and refused to choose. {WITCH_NAME} repeatedly put both books back into the reading partner's hands without taking either one. The reading partner said they would not read together again until {WITCH_NAME} chose for herself and sent the title. A prisoner sitting elsewhere in the lounge saw the whole exchange and saw the reading partner leave both books behind.

Later that day, {WITCH_NAME} sent the reading partner a message naming one of the books. She said it was on their usual sofa and asked the reading partner to begin there while she was on her way back. A prisoner in the corridor saw {WITCH_NAME} leave the lounge, then saw the reading partner enter. No one else crossed the lounge doorway before the prisoner heard the crossbow fire.

The prisoner returned at once. The reading partner lay alone between the sofa and the fireplace, with the named book beside one outstretched hand. A bolt had entered her upper chest and killed her. The loaded lounge crossbow sat at the back of the unlit firebox, aimed at the middle of the sofa. The other book propped up its front.

The prisoners found no cord, weight, catch, or hidden person connecting the book to the trigger, which was beyond the victim's reach. The message on the victim's phone, the victim's position, the book beside her hand, and the bolt's path showed that the crossbow fired as she lifted the book from the sofa. {WITCH_NAME} had placed that book on the sofa, aimed the crossbow with the other book beneath it, then created her one active sequence by touching the book and the trigger in that order and assigning the book's upward direction and the trigger's pull direction. When the victim lifted the book, her force passed through the sequence: the book stayed still, only the trigger moved, and the sequence ended with that movement. Ordered Relay did not add to the force; the crossbow's own spring drove the bolt. {WITCH_NAME}'s message put the victim in the line of fire, and the corridor witness placed {WITCH_NAME} at the finished setup just before the victim entered.
fields.epitaph: This time, the order ended with her.
fields.epithet: The Choice No One Made for Her
execution: THE LAST IN LINE is a straight row of tall, heavy slabs standing on the execution platform. She is restrained face-up just beyond the last slab, with her chest in its path.

The first slab tips into the next, and the whole row falls in one unbroken sequence. The last slab crashes across her sternum and ribs. It pins her chest against the platform and stays there until her breathing and heartbeat stop.

magic.name: Ordered Relay
magic.text: She can relay force through a sequence of objects.
